text:
viv: Quick flag  the /v1/uploads API reference still shows a JSON upload example as primary and a Ruby snippet that does `rest.post json:`. That causes 415s; runtime wants multipart/form-data for binary files. I opened PR #3888 to switch canonical examples and add Ruby/Go FormData-equivalents.

sam: good catch. I hit this when testing the Ruby client too. Our Ruby example needs `Faraday::UploadIO.new('path', 'application/octet-stream')` instead of JSON.

docs-bot: PR #3888 by viv: docs(upload): make multipart canonical, add curl + browser FormData + Ruby Faraday + Go multipart examples; add OpenAPI multipart entry and migration note. (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3888) :white_check_mark:

noah: couple of asks: 1) update OpenAPI requestBody with `multipart/form-data` and keep `application/json` only for remote-url fetches; 2) update response example: runtime now returns `content_ref` and `name` (not `file_id`). I'll update the OpenAPI and run validation.

viv: planned examples: curl (`-F "file=@./sample.bin" -F "purpose=vector_index"`), browser FormData snippet with note not to set Content-Type, Ruby Faraday example using UploadIO, and Go `mime/multipart` example. Also added a tiny acceptance test entry: run curl sample against local dev and assert 2xx and `content_ref` present.

sam: also add a line in docs/sdk/migration.md: "Replace `file_id` with `content_ref` for uploads; content_ref is opaque." I'll coordinate with SDK folks to bump examples.

noah: OpenAPI patch pushed and validated. CI linkcheck flagged our example remote URL; I added a docs/static/sample-files placeholder to avoid linkcheck failures.

docs-bot: CI for PR #3888: docs build + openapi-lint + linkcheck -> green.

viv: merged. Thanks all, closing thread.
